title: Eric Trump: Metaplanet, American Bitcoin and Hut 8
summary: Every core fact checks out: Eric Trump's Metaplanet advisory role (March 21, 2025), the Trump brothers' stake in American Bitcoin, the 80% equity Hut 8 got for contributing its miners in a cashless deal, Prusak's 'capital markets and narrative' quote to Wired, and the stock's collapse. The framing goes too far in suggesting Hut 8 gave away its whole mining business. Hut 8 kept its energy and data-center assets, controls and consolidates American Bitcoin, and earns colocation fees from it. The 'five treasury companies' count is a rough but defensible estimate.

sub_claims.statement: Eric Trump became a strategic board adviser to Japanese bitcoin company Metaplanet.
sub_claims.finding: On March 21, 2025, Metaplanet named Eric Trump the first member of its new Strategic Board of Advisors. This is an advisory board, not the board of directors.

sub_claims.statement: Eric Trump and Donald Trump Jr. are part owners of American Bitcoin.
sub_claims.finding: American Data Centers was formed in February 2025 with Dominari Holdings and the two brothers. It became American Bitcoin on March 31, 2025, with the Trump-linked holders keeping 20%. Eric Trump is co-founder and chief strategy officer; Bloomberg estimated his stake at about 7.5% at the September 2025 listing.

sub_claims.statement: American Bitcoin is 80% owned by Hut 8, an energy infrastructure company.
sub_claims.finding: Hut 8 received 80% of the equity at launch. After the Gryphon Digital Mining all-stock merger and the Nasdaq listing (ABTC, September 3, 2025), Hut 8 holds a majority of the stock and about 80% of the voting power. Hut 8 calls itself an 'energy infrastructure platform'.

sub_claims.statement: Hut 8 contributed its mining equipment in exchange for 80%, with no cash known to have changed hands.
sub_claims.finding: Hut 8's filing and press release confirm it contributed substantially all of its ASIC miners (about 61,000) for newly issued equity, and reports call the deal cashless. However, Hut 8 did not give away '100% of its mining firm'. It kept its power and data-center business, became the exclusive colocation and managed-services provider, and controls and consolidates American Bitcoin.

sub_claims.statement: CEO Matt Prusak told Wired the Trump brothers brought access to capital markets and 'narrative'.
sub_claims.finding: Jessica Klein's Wired feature quotes Prusak saying the brothers brought 'two things to the table': access to capital markets and 'narrative'. The quote was verified via a mirror and reposts; the wired.com original could not be fetched. Prusak later served as president and interim CFO and left on August 4, 2026 for Giga Energy.

sub_claims.statement: The Trump family is linked to about five crypto treasury companies.
sub_claims.finding: Five links can be documented: American Bitcoin (ownership), Trump Media (bitcoin treasury), ALT5 Sigma (WLFI treasury), Thumzup (Don Jr. stake) and Metaplanet (Eric as adviser). The nature of the links varies widely, and I found no published source that gives a count of five.

sub_claims.statement: American Bitcoin stock has performed poorly.
sub_claims.finding: The stock surged at its September 2025 debut, fell about 40% when the lockup expired on December 2, 2025, and was about 70% off its peak by December 2025. By 2026 it was more than 90-95% below its peak, with a 1-for-15 reverse split and an $82M Q1 2026 loss.

corrections: The 'Asher' Eric Trump refers to is Asher Genoot, CEO of Hut 8.

Claimed: Hut 8 gave away '100% of your Bitcoin mining firm'. The record shows: Hut 8 contributed its miner fleet, kept its energy and data-center business, earns colocation and managed-services fees, and controls and consolidates American Bitcoin.
After the Gryphon merger, 80% is Hut 8's approximate voting power rather than exactly its economic stake.
Metaplanet's body is a 'Strategic Board of Advisors', not its board of directors.
denials_and_context: Hut 8 and American Bitcoin present the structure as a way to raise and deploy capital for mining without straining Hut 8's balance sheet.
Eric Trump blamed the December 2025 drop on pre-merger investors taking profits, said he would not sell, and called the company's fundamentals 'virtually unmatched'.
No specific regulatory favour to American Bitcoin is documented. The conflict-of-interest point is inference from the president's crypto policy role, not proof of a quid pro quo.
